title: P13 comparator negative control first planted its defects on encounters outside the sample
what_went_wrong: The first version planted +1 on 2026/02/25/000001 and 2027/09/30/800059, which were not in the N=30 sample, so the comparator correctly reported 0 differences and the control would have been vacuous.
root_cause: The plant targets were chosen without checking they belong to the visits file under test (the same class of defect as the P12 reconcile control, failure record 20261024T1148Z).
detection: The control's own verdict; reported by the agent in its report (Problems item 1).
impact: None on results: fixed before any stage ran (plants moved to sampled visits, ROW_COUNT()=1 asserted); log evidence/p13/negctl/comparator_nc.log.

correction.applied: Plants re-targeted to the first and last sampled visits.
correction.result: Planted run: differences 2, both encounters named; clean run: 0.

rule: A negative control must assert both that its mutation took effect and that its target is inside the checked set.
